/.title: Shreya Raut — UI/UX & Web Designer
/.description: The design portfolio of Shreya Raut, UI/UX and web designer.
p: Hey, I’m Shreya Raut. I’m a Computer Engineering student at Government Polytechnic Mumbai, passionate about software development, AI, and building meaningful digital products.

I love turning ideas into real-world applications, exploring new technologies, and solving problems through code. From web applications to AI-powered projects, I’m always learning, building, and improving.
I believe in creative problem-solving and building solutions that are functional and deliver a great user experience.
Create technology that makes a difference
A few ideas turned into real-world products.
A digital marketplace that helps farmers discover and rent the machinery they need, without the cost of owning every tool.
An AI-powered workspace that turns a plain-language product idea into a structured plan for building.
An AI-assisted marine exploration experience to identify species, explore ocean biodiversity, and revisit previous scans.
